name: battlecard-builder
description: Create competitive battlecards — FIA Framework (Fact → Impact → Act), Why We Win/Why We Lose, objection handling cards per competitor, pricing comparisons, and quick-dismiss summaries. Use when building competitive intelligence, preparing for competitive deals, or creating sales enablement materials. Triggers on: "battlecard", "competitive battlecard", "competitor comparison", "Why We Win", "objection handling card", "competitor intel", or any competitive enablement.
